checks: The literal inventory crate imports resolve through glyph-check root Command/Frame/Rect imports; owned Plan and borrowed SourceMask lifetimes agree with Session API.
Both current CPU cold and warm frames compare every packed u32 pixel with the separately loaded parent reference; exhaustion and mismatches fail, with bounded full actual pixels retained on mismatch.
Private Session preparation does not populate the preexisting Fonts bitmap cache; cold Canvas starts cold and the second Canvas uses that same Fonts warm cache.

All original direct input commands/images, Fonts, temporary masks and warm comparison plans drop before prepare returns. Returned prepared cases own only plans and expected pixels; no font/input leases survive to Vulkan initialization.

Final cold/warm invariance checks include complete BridgeStats, complete TextBridgeStats, Draw records, invocation and GPU-buffer counts, parameter bytes and packed input bytes. Both plans use the same copied Frame.

Full structural/text/key/image preflight precedes mask preparation. Nontext conservative CPU charges and exact reached-mask max(area,1) charges share the original allowance; empty and repeated masks remain charged.

Preflight callbacks bound combined source counts, operation and row counts, coverage/storage estimates before new coverage allocation and raster draw; typed shared scope state preserves fixed restoration and exact x/y translation order.

Original rectangle-only entry retains Text fallback. The seven private groups have coherent setup/expectations for cache independence, hidden input limits, empty glyph repetitions, zero remaining CPU allowance, hidden unsupported scopes/shapes, and image/mask source sharing.

Fixed trusted inventories cap the number of retained plans/reference pixels; reported aggregate retained storage bounds are distinct from transient preparation/warm-plan storage and allocator/driver overhead.
